name: GitHub Build Monitor
author: David JM
description: Real-time GitHub Actions status for every repository owned by the logged-in GitHub account, shown in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Monitors every repository owned by the GitHub account that is currently logged in (gh CLI or GITHUB_TOKEN). A pill in the bar reflects the newest Actions state across those repos and opens a detailed run list. If no account is signed in the pill asks to log in and launches `gh auth login` in a terminal.

schema.label: Extra repositories
schema.description: Comma-separated owner/name pairs to monitor in addition to the logged-in account's own repos, e.g. HANCORE-linux/Shibumi-Shell. Leave empty to watch only the account.

schema.label: Repos from account
schema.description: How many of the account's repositories to monitor, newest-updated first.

schema.label: GitHub token
schema.description: Optional personal access token (also read from the GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable). Overrides the gh CLI login; raises the API rate limit to 5000 req/h.

schema.label: API host
schema.description: Leave empty for github.com. Set for GitHub Enterprise (e.g. github.example.com), with a matching token for that host.
